messages:
megan: Heads-up — automated BMC firmware rollout in us-west-2 toggled Secure Boot and changed OOB VLAN tagging on a small slice of the GPU fleet. PXE/provisioning failing for ~8 nodes. Job id fw-rollout-2026-03-18-09.

arjun: Which nodes? I'm seeing kernel modules not loading on a couple of NGC hosts (GPU drivers failing).

ben: infra-bot shows the job completed but with a VLAN change entry: bmc-fw 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0, default-oob-vlan=300. Affected hosts flagged by the job: node-gpu-3f21, node-gpu-3f22, node-gpu-4a11, node-gpu-4a12, node-gpu-4b01, node-gpu-5c90, node-gpu-5c91, node-gpu-5c92.

infra-bot: [job fw-rollout-2026-03-18-09] completed on 8 hosts at 2026-03-18T09:12:07Z — changes: firmware->3.3.0, oob_vlan=300 (was 1), secure_boot=enabled.

sophia: Secure Boot being enabled explains the driver sig failures — kernels can't load unsigned modules. Can we flip SecureBoot back via Redfish? Example patch: 

```
# toggle secure boot off (example)
curl -k -u admin:REDACTED -X PATCH https://<BMC-IP>/redfish/v1/Systems/1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"SecureBoot": {"Enabled": false}}'
```

megan: Tried that on node-gpu-3f21 but got 503 from Redfish. BMCs are reporting "Network: No IP" after the VLAN change; ipmitool lan print shows DHCP issues and Address Conflict on some nodes. Example output from node-gpu-3f21: 

```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.21 -U admin lan print
Set in Progress         : Set Complete
IP Address Source       : DHCP Address Conflict
IP Address              : 0.0.0.0
Subnet Mask             : 0.0.0.0
Gateway IP Address      : 0.0.0.0
802.1q VLAN ID          : 300
```

arjun: If the VLAN changed, BMC lost lease on our mgmt network. Two options: (1) ask colo to trunk vlan 300 to our oob switch temporarily, or (2) use serial-over-lan (SOL) through the out-of-band backplane if BMC still reachable on old switch. SOL command: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <ip> -U admin sol activate` (if IP reachable).

ben: I'm pausing the rollout and preparing rollback to 3.2.1 for the 8 hosts. Plan: pause job, request colo to allow vlan 300 on our OOB port for 30m, attempt Redfish patch to disable SecureBoot once BMC is reachable, then boot nodes and verify nvidia driver loads. If Redfish is still 503, escalate to on-call field ops for physical console. I'll take owner.

sophia: I'll ping the colo NOC now (ticket: COLO-4627) and ask them to mirror/trunk vlan 300 to our OOB uplink for the affected rack in us-west-2. Also collecting `ipmitool mc info` and `curl https://<bmc>/redfish/v1/Managers` across the list. I'll post outputs here as I get them.

megan: Node list for quick copy: node-gpu-3f21, node-gpu-3f22, node-gpu-4a11, node-gpu-4a12, node-gpu-4b01, node-gpu-5c90, node-gpu-5c91, node-gpu-5c92.

ben: Action items: (1) megan paused rollout (done), (2) sophia to confirm with colo NOC, (3) megan/arjun to attempt SOL + Redfish toggles once BMC network restored, (4) ben to run rollback to 3.2.1 if remote toggles fail, (5) field ops on standby for reseat/console access.

megan: FYI — we saw a separate noisy fan sensor on node-gpu-4b01 after the fw bump (temp spike + sensor index change). If rollback doesn't fix it, leave node out of capacity and tag for field swap.

infra-bot: Rollout fw-rollout-2026-03-18-09 status -> PAUSED by megan at 2026-03-18T09:15:43Z. Affected hosts: 8. Incident ticket created: INFRA-2026-0773.

ben: I'll start the rollback job in 10m if colo confirms VLAN access. Will post job id and progress.

megan: Thanks — keep updates here. If colo can't trunk vlan 300 quickly, we'll coordinate physical console window with field ops.

sophia: Colo replied: NOC will open vlan 300 on the OOB uplink for 45m, ETA 09:40Z. Starting collection now.

arjun: Good. Once we have SOL/Redfish, target sequence: disable secure boot, power cycle, check dmesg/nvidia, re-enable only after signed modules verified.

megan: Copy. I'll mark the affected nodes as draining in the scheduler to avoid noisy alerts.

ben: Rolling up: owner=ben, oncall-field=team-ops, colo-contact=sophia, pause=megan. Will update job id when rollback starts.

megan: Closing loop for now — will post final status after rollback/colocation window.
